issues.title: web: agent 预合并判定票——ready-for-agent PR 由 pacman 自己的 agent 判定「简单可合」并执行合并（吃自己狗粮）
issues.body:
## Motivation

对照 Rakazo（开源 Grok Bot 替代）2026-10-15 的运营实践（https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xk-aLMQRYfk）：作者用一个 agent 每几小时醒来扫 open PR，简单 bug 修复自动合并、大功能留人批。实测本仓近 30 个 merged PR 全部由 xiechimon 亲手合（GitHub 原生 autoMergeRequest 只是「绿了自动 squash」，判定仍来自人）。

本仓已有半边基建：

- 票分级：`scripts/issue-label-gate.mjs` 的 `ready-for-agent` 标签（现为 CI advisory）
- 任务派发：`apps/server` 的 tryClaim / `dispatch-eligibility.ts`（机器认领任务步）
- 验证证据：`pr-evidence` 闸（内嵌截图 + 逐条 200 + SHA 钉链）+ `pr-tasks-gate`（Acceptance 全勾）

缺的是最后半边：**agent 读 PR（diff + 截图 + 闸状态）后判定「简单可合」并执行合并**。这也正是 pacman 产品定位（self-hosted agent workspace）的吃自己狗粮场景——让 pacman 自己的 agent 盯自己的 PR。

## Proposed solution

一个定时任务（cron/常驻 agent，走 pacman 自身或 herdr 派发），每几小时：

1. `gh pr list --label ready-for-agent --state open` 取候选
2. 逐个判定（判定依据进 PR body 或日志，可审计）：
   - 全部 required checks 绿（ci + pr-evidence）
   - diff 规模小、无新缝（不碰 `apps/daemon/src/backend/`、`biome.json`、workflow、AGENTS.md）
   - 无语义风险面：不改 schema/迁移、不改产物闸基线（ui-debt-baseline 等）
   - Acceptance 清单全勾（pr-tasks-gate 已绿 = 已满足）
   - PR body 截图面与改动面一致（可见改动必须有内嵌截图）
3. 判「可合」→ squash merge；判「留人批」→ 评论判定理由，不加标签不加噪音

红线（任一命中即留人批，绝不静默放行）：恶意/越权 diff、改闸脚本自身、依赖文件变更、与开放 lane 冲突的文件面。

## Alternatives considered

- 只用 GitHub 原生 auto-merge：绿了自动合，但「简单 vs 大功能」的语义判定缺失，等于把人审砍掉而不是分流——不可接受
- 用第三方 bot（mergify 等）：判据黑盒 + 第三方依赖，与本仓「第三方 action 钉 SHA」的缝纪律相悖
- 只加「建议合并」评论不执行合并：安全但半途，判定产物（理由）已产出的情况下执行是增量一步；可作第一阶段灰度

## Acceptance

- [ ] 判定逻辑有独立脚本（仓内 `scripts/` 或 agent 技能），判据逐条可检查
- [ ] 灰度期仅输出判定评论不执行合并，攒 N 个 PR 判定样本人工复盘后再开执行
- [ ] 执行期所有自动合并的 PR 带可追溯标记（commit/PR 注记），可一键回滚审计
- [ ] 判定脚本自身在闸保护面内（改它必须过 pr-evidence + 人审）
comments:
2026-10-23 按排期关闭（ian 确认）：被 spec 28 / ADR 0021 替代。合并闸 #1404 加自治合并执行器 #1405 做的就是「agent 判定能否合并并执行」，判定更严且绑定 head SHA。

issues.title: server: 自举闭环 P2 GitHub PR 面 + 合并对账（merged 回推 done、BEHIND/DIRTY、按 head SHA 读 checks）
issues.body:
## 现状

- `apps/server/src/lib/github.ts` 的写操作只有建 issue、改 issue 标题；没有读 PR 状态、update-branch、merge、commit status。
- GitHub 形态的「完成 + 合并」：daemon 把 `origin/main` 合进 conv 分支再 push，server `applyMergeLanding`（`machines.ts:2024`）对非 hosted 直接返回，todo 变 `done` 但 PR 没合；合并实际靠 LLM 服从 `prompts.ts:40` 那句 prompt。
- PR 在 GitHub 上被人手动合并，pacman 察觉不到，卡停在 `review`。
- `ci-loop.ts` 只看 `building` 的 build；按分支 ref 读 check-runs；neutral / skipped / cancelled 一律算绿。
- 疑似缺陷（只读推断）：review 关口 `wakeFacts`（`chief.ts:638-662`）给 chief 的是 confirm 关口的「自动确认」文案，chief 调 `confirm_builds` 会先落「通过了确认」行再 409。

spec 28 P2（随 #1401 进 main）。

## 范围

- `lib/github.ts`：读 PR（state / merged / draft / mergeable_state / head.sha）、update-branch（带 expected_head_sha）、merge（带 sha）、commit status、compare 文件列表、PR 评审与评论读取。端点按官方文档核实。
- 对账环：候选扩到 `building | review` 的 GitHub 形态 build：PR 已合并 → `done` + system 行写合并 SHA + 推进 split 波次；关闭未合并 → `failed`；BEHIND → update-branch（`human` 策略下只提示）；DIRTY → 同分支 `[merge-conflict]` build 步。
- check-runs 按 head SHA 读，只认必需检查名单。
- GitHub 形态「完成 + 合并」改为 server 经 API 合并（带 sha）。
- G9：先写失败测试复现，再改 review 关口文案。

## 失败方式

- GitHub 429 / 404 / 网络错：fail-open 不动，下轮重试。
- 人工在网络窗口里推进了 phase：写前重读。
- merge 返回 405（不可合）：下轮重评，不重试轰炸。
- merge 成功但响应丢失：下轮对账看到 merged 收尾，不重复合并。
- 同一 PR 被两个 build 指向（#1217 守卫）。
- update-branch 与 agent 推送竞态：`expected_head_sha` 不符即放弃本轮。

## 验收

- [ ] 集成测试（假 GitHub）覆盖 merged / closed / BEHIND / DIRTY 四态
- [ ] check-runs 按 head SHA 读的单元测试，含 neutral / skipped 不算绿
- [ ] 人工「完成 + 合并」走 API 合并的集成测试
- [ ] G9 失败测试先红后绿
- [ ] 宿主实测：GitHub 网页手动合并后 1 分钟内卡变 done（待宿主）
- [ ] lint / typecheck / spec:parse / vitest related / e2e:affected 通过
comments:
Items for segment 2 of P2. They come from pr-gate runs 8 to 10 on #1414; segment 1 ended with a go at `f8ab21b`.

1. **The build's PR identity.** The reconcile trusts `build.prNumber`, and the daemon probe refreshes it only when a non-review step finishes. That can go wrong in two ways:
   - A person closes PR #N and opens #M from the same conversation branch while the card is in review. The closed read then fails the card while #M is open, and after a restore a merge of #M is not seen.
   - A second build can record an existing PR whose head is the older build's branch. Run 9 pinned this as foreign: it gets a hint and the card stays in review.

   Before failing on a close, read the open PRs for `head=owner:<conv branch>`, or let the merge step own the PR through the API.
2. **Merge step through the API with `sha`.** This is the user's decision B on #1414: the completion row then always means the PR is merged.
3. **Test pins with no test at `f8ab21b`.** Each was shown by a mutation that survives:
   - a closed outcome is reported once per round: a second sweep after the reopen in ⑱d and ⑱f;
   - `roundStart` counts only build and plan steps;
   - `closedSeenAt` is cleared when the card leaves review;
   - a failed build step's pushed checkpoint does not decide containment;
   - the stopped-step filter.
4. **Exact step finish time.** The checkpoint order uses the last heartbeat. Two overlapping steps that finish less than 30 s apart can be ordered wrongly. An exact order needs a `finishedAt` column, which means a migration.
5. **`githubTarget` routing.** If #1468 merges after #1414, route `githubTarget` in `ci-loop.ts` through `githubRepoOfProject`. If #1414 merges after #1468, its merge does the routing.

_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

The user decided two points in the session chat on 2026-10-22.

**1. The merge through the API follows design D.** When a person presses merge on a GitHub-form task whose build has a PR, `requestMerge` merges the PR through `PUT pulls/{n}/merge`. No machine merge step is queued. The call uses:
- `sha`: the build's last pushed checkpoint;
- squash;
- `commit_title`: `<PR title> (#n)`;
- the D2 closing line `closes #N`, added only when the task's source is an issue of the same repository.

What happens next depends on GitHub's answer:
- **Merged:** one merged row, then `finishTodoDone`.
- **Refused (4xx):** a 409 that carries GitHub's message, cleaned. Nothing is written to the timeline, and the person can press merge again.
- **Unknown** (timeout, network error, 5xx, rate limit): 202 and one row. Segment 1's merged read finishes the card on the next sweep.

Related rules:
- While the PUT runs, the sweep does not write for that build.
- A merge step queued before the upgrade does not finish a GitHub-form build that has a PR.
- GitHub-form builds without a PR, hosted projects and local projects keep today's merge step.
- `sha` binds to the exact last checkpoint. A branch updated on GitHub needs segment 3's update-branch, or a person, before the merge goes through.

Design P was the alternative: keep the machine merge step, then merge at its pushed head on the next sweep. It is not taken.

**2. The confirm-phase check stays.** A confirm is accepted only in the confirm phase. In two cases this answers 409 where a duplicate build step used to be queued:
- a second confirm while the task is building;
- a confirm on a queued direct-execution task.

Segment 2 (items 2, 3, 4 and 6 of the segment-2 list) goes up as its own PR. The API merge is segment 2b, built on that branch.

Decision recorded 2026-10-22, amending the segment 2b decision above ([comment](https://github.com/xiechimon/pacman/issues/1403#issuecomment-6338182522)): rate limits move out of the Unknown class.

When pressing merge in pacman gets a 429 or a rate-limited 403 from GitHub's `PUT pulls/{n}/merge`, the server answers 409 with GitHub's cleaned message and the wait time when known. Nothing is written, and a failed card stays failed. The reason: a rate-limited request was not processed, so the merge did not happen; treating it as Unknown would leave the card at review waiting for a merge that never comes.

The user confirmed this in the session conversation, choosing the 409 behaviour over the original Unknown (202) class. It is the behaviour on #1509.

issues.title: server: 自举闭环 P4 自治合并执行器（mergePolicy、sha 绑定合并、急停、熔断、日上限）
issues.body:
## 现状

合并只由人触发（ADR 0018、#1256）。ADR 0021（#1401）把合并权改为项目级策略 `mergePolicy = human | shadow | autonomous`，默认 `human`。P3（#1404）提供 `mergeReadiness`。

spec 28 P4（随 #1401 进 main），依赖 #1401 与 #1404。本票 PR 按 D7 由用户合并：它把合并权交给机器。

## 范围

- 迁移：`project.mergePolicy`（默认 `human`）、团队级 `autonomyPaused`、`maxAutonomousMergesPerDay`（默认 10）。迁移序号按合并时点 main 尾部 +1。
- 合并执行器（scheduler 家族，60s）：`autonomous` 且 `mergeReadiness.ready` → REST merge 带 `sha`，squash，message 由 server 拼（PR 标题 + 末行 `closes #<sourceRef 的 issue 号>`）。一仓一轮最多合一个。`shadow` 只写 status 与「本应在 <sha> 合并」的 system 行。
- 刹车：急停（UI 开关 + REST + `pacman autonomy pause`，下一轮生效）；熔断（自治合并产生的 main 提交 CI 转红 → 暂停自治 + 开回滚 PR，回滚 PR 走 `human` + 通知）；日上限。
- `human` 下 chief `merge_builds` 继续硬挡；`autonomous` 下 chief 只能「请求合并」，仍过 `mergeReadiness`。
- 开工先跑 `design-panel` workflow（spec 28 §7.5）。

## 失败方式

- merge 成功但响应丢失：下轮对账看到 merged 收尾，不重复合并。
- 两个执行器实例并发（server 重启重叠）：`sha` 参数 + 库内合并锁去重。
- 急停与合并同一秒落下：合并前最后一次读开关。
- 日上限跨时区计数错位：以 UTC 日计并在界面写明。
- `shadow` 误合并：执行器对 `shadow` 无写 merge 的代码路径（单元测试钉住）。

## 验收

- [ ] `human` / `shadow` / `autonomous` 三档单元测试，`shadow` 零 merge 调用
- [ ] 急停、日上限、熔断各一条集成测试（假 GitHub）
- [ ] 重复合并防护集成测试（响应丢失场景）
- [ ] 宿主实测：演练仓上 shadow 与 autonomous 各跑通一次，急停与熔断各演一次（待宿主）
- [ ] lint / typecheck / spec:parse / vitest related / e2e:affected 通过
- [ ] 本票 PR 由用户合并（D7）
comments:
P4 plan from the design-panel workflow (spec 28 §7.5): three designs (minimal change, risk first, operator first) were scored by independent judges, Design 2 is the base with grafts from the other two, and the plan below splits P4 into segments P4-0 to P4-6. Nothing is implemented yet. P4-0 depends on #1420 and #1421 (P3 S1 and S2). The four open questions at the end need a decision before P4-3 (question 1), before turning anything on (questions 2 and 3) and before P4-4 (question 4); they will be asked on the PR that first needs each answer.

## Scores

| Design | Safety | Smallness | Operability | Testability | Total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 Minimal change | 7 | 8 | 6 | 8 | 29 |
| 2 Risk first | 9 | 6 | 7 | 9 | **31** |
| 3 Operator first | 6 | 4 | 9 | 6 | 25 |

**Design 1**
- **Safety 7.** The ledger is claimed before the PUT, there is one finisher, and the DB is re-read last. Four gaps:
  - The mergePolicy write path ships in P4-1 and the executor (P4-5b) ships before the breaker (P4-6). A deploy between those segments can merge with no breaker.
  - The lock is per project, not per repo.
  - A 403 rate limit, or a 405 after the PR already merged, is classed `rejected` with no PR read.
  - A merge at a head other than the sha sent is never noticed.
- **Smallness 8.** One table, an extension of the existing PATCH, and it reuses quota_wait, reconcile and the check-runs reader.
- **Operability 6.** No executor heartbeat. The 3h main-CI timeout just unlocks the repo and writes a hint row. A merge shows on GitHub as the user's.
- **Testability 8.** Injected `evaluate`, a `mergePull` spy that throws when called, explicit-`now` UTC boundary tests, and two DB handles.

**Design 2**
- **Safety 9.** One IMMEDIATE transaction re-checks every condition and commits `sent` before the PUT. It adds a partial unique index per repoKey, a `merged_foreign` invariant, an up-to-date check against the admin bypass, a fail-closed #1217 check, a no-op when the evaluator is null, and the policy write path last. Minus one for a second compare read the gate already makes, and an ad hoc "expected names" rule.
- **Smallness 6.** Seven ledger states, an attempt counter, per-repo backoff and a dedicated policy endpoint.
- **Operability 7.** Pause returns an inFlight list, and lastSweepAt is exposed. The UI arrives only in the last segment, and the audit trail is notifications only.
- **Testability 9.** Each mechanism has a named test: two `openDb` connections, `TZ=Asia/Shanghai`, `expectTypeOf<ShadowDeps>`, a source scan, and a pause inside the fake PUT handler.

**Design 3**
- **Safety 6.** Asymmetric authority, and `autonomous` returning 409 until the brakes exist, are strong. Against that:
  - The executor calls `finishTodoDone` itself. That function writes `DONE_ROW` on every call (p2 `builds.ts:1885`), and P2 reconcile is already the finisher.
  - A breaker timeout never pauses.
  - There is no `merged_foreign` check and no up-to-date check.
  - Optional S9 adds a second merge path.
- **Smallness 4.** Ten segments plus one optional, two new tables, a new page, a banner, a verdict endpoint, and edits to the chief prompt and the reconcile wording.
- **Operability 9.** A `Pacman-Merge:` trailer, the exact payload stored in the ledger, an event log, a heartbeat, and a shadow agreement view that produces P8-1's metric.
- **Testability 6.** Server legs are solid, but much of the value sits in UI e2e. A single conditional INSERT for both cap and lock is hard to pin condition by condition.

**Base: Design 2.**
- From Design 1:
  - a single round entry point, so unwiring it stops the breaker and merges together;
  - shadow runs only on the S6a snapshot, with no network;
  - the executor writes its own merge row;
  - chief "request" is read-only from the snapshot, and MCP is unchanged;
  - the quota_wait notification pattern;
  - explicit-`now` tests.
- From Design 3:
  - the `Pacman-Merge:` trailer and the exact commit title and message stored on the ledger row;
  - a `mode` column, so shadow decisions can be queried for P8-1;
  - machine credentials can lower autonomy, never raise it;
  - the heartbeat shown in the UI;
  - `autonomous` refused with 409 until its preconditions hold.

## Plan

### Basis (checked in the code and docs; refs are branch:path)

1. **P3 readiness** (`p3b:apps/server/src/services/merge-gate/readiness.ts`).
   - `mergeReadiness` blocks only on `policy-human`, so shadow can be `ready`.
   - `GateInputs.policy` carries only `{mergePolicy, autonomyPaused}`.
   - `stepsInFlight` and `issueNumber` are supplied by the shell, not computed here.
   - The lists come from `'@pacman/shared'`, the index re-export that the #1404 comment flagged.
2. **P2 reconcile and builds** (`p2:apps/server/src/services/ci-loop.ts` and `builds.ts`).
   - `hasActiveStep` is closure-private. It counts a claimed step of any kind, and a pending or waiting_quota step that is not verify or review.
   - `reconcileOne` finishes through `finishTodoDone` after checking that the merged head contains the last checkpoint. It dedupes through `settled()` on `DONE_ROW` since `roundStart`.
   - `mergedPrElsewhere` fails open (`builds.ts:878`).
3. **P2 GitHub transport** (`p2:apps/server/src/lib/github.ts`).
   - `writeJson` accepts only `'POST' | 'PATCH'`.
   - `mapUpstreamStatus` maps 409 to a 502 "repo is empty", and every other non-404/429 status to 502.
   - `githubPull` has no `title` or `node_id`.
   - `githubCommitCheckRuns(ref)` is a conditional GET and accepts a sha ref.
   - `FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS` is 15 s.
4. **Scheduler** (`main:scheduler.ts`). The ciTimer runs `ciPoller.sweep().catch(() => {})` every 60 s; `tick()` is synchronous.
5. **Database.**
   - WAL mode and no busy_timeout pragma, so better-sqlite3's default 5000 ms timeout applies.
   - drizzle 0.45.2 `transaction(fn, {behavior:'immediate'})` is confirmed in `session.js`.
   - There is a partial-unique-index precedent, `agent_team_persona_unique`.
   - The migration tail is 0043 on main and on all three branches; P3 S3 also adds one.
6. **Team and project routes.**
   - `GET /api/teams` serves the in-memory `ctx.team` (`routes-core.ts:46`).
   - `patchProjectBodySchema` is `.strict()` with five keys, and `updateProject` returns 400 when all five are missing.
7. **Machine auth.** `token-auth.ts` exempts `/api/machine/*`. `machineJsonSchema` stores the token in plaintext.
8. **Shared package.** `@pacman/shared` exports only `.`. The server uses NodeNext and esbuild, which both resolve subpath exports. `packages/shared/package.json` is D4 ③.
9. **Chief and MCP.**
   - Chief `merge_builds` returns `{rejected:true, buildIds, reason: MERGE_HUMAN_ONLY_COPY}` (`chief-tools.ts:863-870`); MCP returns 403 (`mcp-face.ts:365`).
   - Chief `connect_repo` rewrites `project.githubRepo` with no other check.
   - `chief.ts:797` says merges are human-only.
10. **Notifications and settings UI.**
    - `notification.type` is a TS union on a text column.
    - Web `notificationHref` sends every non-chief type to `/app/todo/<entityId>`. A team-scoped notification needs its own branch.
    - The settings tab is local `useState('basic')`, so there is no deep link.
11. **GitHub facts.**
    - Main protection is `enforcement_level: non_admins`, with required contexts `check, pack-smoke, e2e-gate, pr-evidence` (public branches API).
    - `pr-evidence.yml` runs only on `pull_request`, so a main commit never carries it. `ci.yml` runs on push to main with no concurrency cancel.
    - `PUT pulls/{n}/merge` takes `sha, merge_method, commit_title, commit_message` and answers 200, 403, 404, 405, 409 or 422. The docs recommend merge-async.
    - GraphQL `revertPullRequest(input:{pullRequestId,title,body,draft})` exists.
    - The check-runs `filter` defaults to `latest`.
12. **Source refs.** `parseGithubIssueSourceRef` does not compare owner/repo with the project.

### Order and routing

- **Order:** P4-0 → P4-1 → P4-3 → P4-4 → P4-5 → P4-6. P4-2 runs in parallel with P4-1, and P4-3 needs both.
- **Who merges:** every P4 PR is merged by the user (D7 and the ticket). The D4 field says what pr-gate would force on its own.
- **Commit messages:** "Part of #1405", except P4-6, which ends with `closes #1405`.
- **No merges before P3 is done:** the production evaluator is `null` until P3 S6a lands, so the round does nothing. Readiness also blocks on `decision-missing` until S8 exists.

### P4-0 Gate prerequisites (pure functions, no schema)

**Depends on:** #1420 and #1421 merged.

**Files**
- `packages/shared/package.json`: add `"./merge-gate": "./src/records/merge-gate.ts"`.
- `packages/shared/src/records/merge-gate.ts`: new blockers `daily-cap` (policy) and `pr-behind-base` (transient).
- `apps/server/src/services/merge-gate/{readiness,paths,digest,evidence-link}.ts`:
  - import the lists only from `'@pacman/shared/merge-gate'`;
  - add `GateInputs.policy.dailyCapReached`;
  - add `GateInputs.pr.baseBehindBy: number | null`. S4 fills it from the compare response it already reads for the digest.
- `apps/server/test/merge-gate-imports.test.ts`, `apps/server/test/merge-gate-readiness.test.ts`.

**Tests (written first)**
- A source scan that fails on today's `'@pacman/shared'` imports of `PROTECTED_PATH_GLOBS`, `AUTO_MERGE_PATH_GLOBS`, `MERGE_BLOCKERS` and `GATE_LIMITS`.
- `daily-cap`: a true leg and a false leg.
- `pr-behind-base`: 0 passes; greater than 0 blocks; `null` blocks.
- The `MERGE_BLOCKER_CODES` completeness assertion.
- The existing S1 and S2 suites stay unchanged.

**D4:** ③ and ④.

### P4-1 Schema, DB policy resolver and read paths (no write path)

**Files:** `apps/server/src/db/schema.ts`, `apps/server/drizzle/00NN_autonomous_merge.sql` with `meta/_journal.json` and `meta/00NN_snapshot.json` (NN = main tail + 1 at merge time), `packages/shared/src/tables.ts`, `packages/shared/src/records/project.ts`, `apps/server/src/services/git.ts`, `apps/server/src/services/merge-gate/policy.ts`, and the tests below.

**Schema**
- `project.mergePolicy`: text, not null, default `'human'`.

## Failure modes

| Mode | Handling | Test |
|---|---|---|
| Merge lands, response lost or times out | `sent` is committed before the PUT and the outcome becomes `unknown`. The next round's PR read with the same head gives `merged`. Reconcile is the only finisher. | P4-3: 1 PUT over 3 rounds, 1 `DONE_ROW`, cap count 1 |
| Request lost before the merge, or crash between commit and fetch | After 120 s, open at the same head becomes `lapsed`. At most 2 attempts per (build, head), each needing a fresh ready. | P4-3: exactly 2 PUTs, never 3 |
| Two executors (overlap, restart, two processes) | In-process reentry flag. Across processes, the IMMEDIATE claim plus the partial unique index on repoKey; `BUSY` or a unique violation means `lost`. `sha` is the platform backstop. | P4-1 and P4-3 two-connection tests |
| Head moves before the PUT | `sha` makes GitHub answer 409, classified `rejected` (not "repo is empty"). No retry at that head. | P4-2 table; P4-3 409 leg |
| 405, 422, 403 or 404 | One PR read separates "already merged" from a rejection. 403 and 404 notify. Rate-limit 403 and 429 become `unknown`. | P4-2 table; P4-3 405 leg |
| Several ready PRs in one repo, or two projects on one repo | Slot keyed by repoKey, one send per repo per round, and no new claim until the previous merge's main CI settles. | P4-3 |
| Pause during evaluate, or in the same second as a send | Pause and policy are re-read inside the claim transaction. If the send commits first, the pause response names it in inFlight. | P4-4 hook tests |
| Shadow reaches a merge | Snapshot only, no writer in its deps type, no import; the claim requires `=== 'autonomous'`. | P4-3: spy, `expectTypeOf`, scan |
| Human projects change behavior | Excluded before any network call; chief returns the byte-identical literal; MCP stays 403. | P4-3, P4-6 |
| Cap miscounted (time zone, crash, race) | `utcDay` is integer days since the epoch, counted inside the claim; `unknown` and `merged_foreign` count. | P4-1 and P4-4 boundary, TZ and race tests |
| Main turns red after a merge | Pause (transaction) → notification → one revert. The revert PR has no build. | P4-5 |
| Breaker trips falsely or misses | Only ledger commits are watched; pending, empty and cancelled are not red; green needs the parent's names; the timeout pauses as `unverified`. | P4-5 |
| Revert sent twice, lost or conflicting | `revertState` CAS before the call, never retried; the pause comes first. | P4-5 |
| PR merged at a head other than the sha sent | Head check after the merge, in protected code: `merged_foreign` blocks claims and pauses. | P4-3, P4-5 |
| Human merge step or "完成" click concurrent (F2) | Any open step blocks the claim; `requestMerge` returns 409 while a row is in flight. | P4-3 |
| Card moved, new build, or `DONE_ROW` written twice | The claim re-reads phase, `latestBuildId` and `DONE_ROW`; the executor never finishes the todo. | P4-3 |
| Wrong `closes #N` or an injected keyword | Same-repo sourceRef only; the title is refused; no PR body in the message. | P4-2 |
| Chief `connect_repo` repoints an autonomous project | The claim requires `githubRepo` to equal the evaluated repoKey; the sourceRef check and digest-bound verdicts also stop it. | P4-3 githubRepo flip leg |
| No token, bad cipher, or token without write access | Zero requests and a hint; 403/404 recorded with a notification. | P4-3, P4-4 |
| #1217 second PR already merged | Fail-closed check of earlier PR builds before evaluating. | P4-3 |
| Admin bypass (`non_admins`) | The `pr-behind-base` blocker, readiness requiring green checks and `mergeable_state`, and `sha`. | P4-0, P4-3 |
| Loop dies silently, or a PR unwires the breaker | One round entry point; heartbeat in `GET` and the UI; per-candidate try/catch. | P4-3, P4-4 |
| P3 evaluator missing | Injected as `null` → no-op. | P4-3 |
| Policy write path before the brakes | The dedicated endpoint lands last; PATCH stays at 400. | P4-1, P4-6 |
| Stale `ctx.team` | Every read goes to the DB. | P4-1, P4-4 |
| CLI 401 under `PACMAN_TOKEN`, or an agent resumes | Machine route that can only pause; no resume route. | P4-4 |
| Index re-export shadows the gate lists | `@pacman/shared/merge-gate` subpath. | P4-0 scan |
| Migration number collision | Renumber at merge; `db:check`. | P4-1 |
| Machine merge looks like the user's on GitHub | `Pacman-Merge:` trailer; exact payload on the ledger row; the executor's own system row. | P4-2, P4-3 |

issues.title: server,daemon: 自举闭环 P5 自主进料与仓规内化（issue 轮询、chief GitHub 读工具、PR 评论回灌）
issues.body:
## 现状

- 进料只有 webhook `issues/labeled`（标 `pacman`），而 server 在 tailnet 内 GitHub 打不进来；没有 issue 轮询。
- chief 与 MCP 的 `issues` / `pull_requests` / `workflow_runs` 读工具返回空（`chief-tools.ts:393-398`、`mcp-face.ts:270-275`）。
- PR 上的人类或 bot 评审评论不回灌到 build。
- in-product agent 是否在 daemon worktree 里读到 `AGENTS.md`、能用 `pr-pacman` / `verify-pacman`、能跑 lint / typecheck / spec:parse，未系统实测。

spec 28 P5（随 #1401 进 main）。D5：只领带 `ready-for-agent`、且该标签由 owner / collaborator 打上的 open issue。

## 范围

- P5a issue 轮询（5 分钟，scheduler 家族）：按 D5 过滤（events API 核打标人），导入（`sourceRef` 409 防重）→ `orchestrateTodo`；项目级在飞上限（默认 3）。
- chief `issues` / `pull_requests` / `workflow_runs` 改成真读（只读）。
- P5b `autonomous` 下 PR 评审评论进同分支修复轮（`[ci-fix]` 同形）。
- 仓规内化实测：不成立的补到 run brief（spec 24）或 Implementer persona 文案。分支内提交形态 `<kind>: <title>` 不改，main 上的 squash message 由 P4 的 server 拼接对齐仓规。
- 开工先跑 `understand` workflow（spec 28 §7.5）。

## 失败方式

- 同一 issue 被 webhook 与轮询各导一次：409 兜住，落测试。
- 非协作者打的标（不可能，但 events 读失败时）：读不到打标人 = 不领。
- issue 派发后被摘标：不中途撤，不再领新票。
- 被领的 issue 在 GitHub 上关了：对账收尾为 `closed`。
- issue 正文含指令：一律当数据，不进 system 层。
- 轮询打满 GitHub 速率：条件请求 + 每轮一次列表读。

## 验收

- [ ] 轮询过滤单元测试（标签、打标人、已导入、在飞上限）
- [ ] webhook 与轮询重复导入的集成测试
- [ ] chief 三个读工具返回真数据的集成测试（假 GitHub）
- [ ] PR 评论回灌修复轮集成测试
- [ ] 仓规内化实测记录进 `docs/verify/<票号>/`
- [ ] 宿主实测：演练仓打标 → 无人介入出 PR，body 一次过 pr-evidence（待宿主）
- [ ] lint / typecheck / spec:parse / vitest related / e2e:affected 通过
comments:
P5 plan after the `understand` workflow (spec 28 §7.5: four read-only readers over the issue intake, the GitHub transport and scheduler, the chief / MCP read tools, and the daemon run path). P5b (PR review comments into fix rounds) needs P4 and is not in these segments.

## What the readers found

- Intake today is the webhook only (`webhook.ts`): `issues` + `labeled` + label `pacman`, repo matched to a project by exact `githubRepo`, then `importGithubIssue` and `orchestrateTodo`. The payload schema does not read `sender`, so nothing checks who applied the label.
- The 409 dedupe is an application check (`claimedSourceRefs`, team-scoped), not a DB constraint, and `importGithubIssue` awaits two GitHub reads between the check and `createTodo`, so two concurrent imports of one issue can both pass.
- `orchestrateTodo` needs a chief bound to an agent with a model (409 otherwise). The webhook commits the todo first, so a 409 there leaves a todo that is never orchestrated and every redelivery reads as duplicate.
- Issue reads in `lib/github.ts` need a token; there is no anonymous path. `githubTarget` / `tokenFor` exist only inside p2's `ci-loop.ts` (#1414), closure-private.
- The scheduler's ciTimer block (`scheduler.ts`) is the seam for a second network loop; `tick()` stays free of network reads. `scheduler.ts` is untouched by #1414, #1420 and #1421.
- The chief and MCP `issues` / `pull_requests` / `workflow_runs` tools return empty stubs (`chief-tools.ts`, `mcp-face.ts`).
- The Implementer persona (`packages/shared/src/records/persona.ts`) names none of the repo's rules (pr-pacman, verify-pacman, commit shape, gates). An issue body becomes `todo.spec` verbatim and reaches the prompt unfenced.
- Overlap with open PRs: #1414 rewrites parts of `lib/github.ts` and `ci-loop.ts`; P5 adds its reads in a separate region of `lib/github.ts` and does not touch `ci-loop.ts`.

## Segments

1. **P5a-1 issue intake poller** (server). A 5-minute loop beside the ciTimer. Per GitHub project of a team with a token and a bound chief: one conditional list read of open issues labeled `ready-for-agent`; for each new candidate, the newest `labeled` event for that label must be by a user whose permission on the repo is triage or above (D5). Import oldest first up to the per-project in-flight cap (3), then `orchestrateTodo`. Issues closed on GitHub close their todo.
2. **P5a-2 chief / MCP GitHub read tools** (server, shared protocol). Real reads for `issues`, `pull_requests`, `workflow_runs`, one shared implementation, issue bodies out of lists and fenced as data where shown.
3. **P5-3 repo rules for the in-product agent** (shared persona, prompt). Persona text names pr-pacman, verify-pacman, the commit and PR title shape and the gates; issue-sourced specs are fenced as data in the task prompt. The live check (engine reads AGENTS.md in a daemon worktree, skills usable, gates run, body passes pr-evidence) needs a long-lived host and a daemon with model credentials: 待宿主.

## Failure modes for segment 1 (tests are written from these first)

1. `ready-for-agent` applied by someone without triage or above, for example by an issue template on an outside author's issue: not taken.
2. Events read or permission read fails (429, 5xx, timeout, malformed, 404): not taken this sweep, read again next sweep.
3. The label was removed and added again: only the newest `labeled` event for the label counts. More events than the read covers: not taken.
4. Pull requests in the issues list: skipped.
5. Already imported by the webhook, by an earlier sweep, or as a self-issue: 409, counted as claimed, not orchestrated again.
6. Webhook and poller import the same issue at once: an in-process claim on the sourceRef taken before the GitHub reads; the second import gets 409.
7. Project at the cap (3 github-issue todos not done or closed): nothing imported; candidates over the remaining room wait for the next sweep, oldest first.
8. No chief bound: the project is skipped before any import, so no todo is left un-orchestrated.
9. No token, bad cipher, token without access (403/404): project skipped, logged, no anonymous reads.
10. Label removed after the import: the todo is not withdrawn.
11. Issue closed on GitHub: its todo moves to `closed` through the existing close path that stops steps; a todo in review is left to the PR reconcile (#1414), so a merge that closes the issue still ends in done.
12. Issue body with instructions: stored as data in `todo.spec`; fencing in the prompt is segment 3.
13. Sweeps do not overlap; a 304 on the list read costs no rate limit; permission answers are cached per login.
14. Malformed `githubRepo`, non-GitHub project, two projects on one repo: skipped or deduped team-wide.

The webhook's `pacman` trigger is left as it is; it predates D5 and changing who it accepts would remove behavior, so that question goes to the PR.

Follow-up items from pr-gate run 1 on #1475 (segment 3), kept for a later P5 segment:

1. **Split children lose the issue's origin.** A split child of an issue-sourced task has no `sourceKind`, so its text is not fenced. A title the chief copies from the issue can then reach the worker prompt unfenced. Giving children the origin needs care: the `sourceRef` dedupe (`claimedSourceRefs`) must not count a child as a second import of the same issue.
2. **A quoted line inside the fence can suppress the daemon's delivery notes.** The idempotency checks that skip adding the attachment or plan notes match the note text anywhere in the prompt, including a `> ` line an issue author wrote. This predates #1475.

The two blocking findings of that run, attachment token lines inside the fence and the unfenced title in chief wake prompts, are fixed in a follow-up PR from main (branch `claude/bootstrap-p5-3-fix`).

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

More P5 follow-up items. They come from pr-gate run 1 on #1477 and from the second /code-review pass of #1461's round 5. All are design calls or touch security-sensitive paths, so they are kept out of the P5 follow-up PR (branch `claude/bootstrap-p5-r5`).

1. **A webhook refusal is final.** A refused `pacman` label (for example at the cap, or after a transient permission-read failure) is not retried, so a maintainer has to apply it again. GitHub does not redeliver after a 2xx.
2. **The webhook does not apply the poller's app-label refusal.** A `pacman` label applied by an agent acting for the owner still imports.
3. **Agents can feed the intake through the team's connection token.** The token reaches the environment of git hooks and of the repo's `.agents/setup` / `.agents/resume` hooks, and agent steps can run the machine's logged-in `gh`. Labels applied that way are not GitHub App labels, so the app-label check does not see them. The fix sits in daemon credential paths (`/security-review` list). Spec 28 §5's premortem should name this.
4. **A review task without a PR is never closed when its issue closes.** The close reconcile skips `review`, and #1414 only settles review tasks that have a PR.
5. **`closerVerdict` accepts an issue close made through a GitHub App,** while the labeler check refuses an app-applied label.

#1481 covers attachment access, which came out of #1480's gate.

issues.title: skills,server: 自举闭环 P6 纠错回路与园丁（correct skill、纠错票触发、每周园丁定时任务）
issues.body:
## 现状

仓里的闸已经很多（ui-debt / registry / consumer-shape / lane-file / spec-parse / drizzle drift / pr-evidence），但「一次纠正 → 升一级成闸」没有机制：纠正发生后靠人记得去写闸。棘轮基线只降不升，但没有人定期去压低它们。

poteto 演讲（2026-09-21）的纠错阶梯：codebase > static analysis（lint / compiler / ci）> rules / bugbot > skills > style guide，越靠前越好；园丁：删债 → 单一铺装路 → lint 反模式。

spec 28 P6（随 #1401 进 main），依赖 P4（#1405）。

## 范围

- 新增仓内 skill `.claude/skills/correct/`：输入一次纠正（自治合并被回滚、人在 review 关口打回、`shadow` 期误放），按阶梯定级，优先最高可行级，产出一张带 `correction` 标签的票；新闸必须拿那次真实失误做负对照。
- 触发：回滚、打回、同一类 blocking 发现第二次出现 → chief 开纠错票。改闸属 D4 保护路径，合并留人。
- 园丁：每周一次定时任务，压低棘轮基线（ui-debt、lint-warning-cap、feature-map 陈旧基线）、清死类、刷新 feature map；每项开普通票。

## 失败方式

- 纠错票泛滥：同一失误类合并为一张票（按类别去重）。
- 新闸没有负对照就合入：skill 要求附上「旧失误在新闸下红」的输出。
- 园丁票与在飞改动冲突：园丁只开票，不直接改码。
- `correction` 标签不在 issue-label-gate 词表：标签与分类、状态标签并存，不替代。

## 验收

- [ ] `correct` skill 存仓，SKILL.md 含定级规则与负对照要求
- [ ] chief 开纠错票的触发有集成测试（假回滚、假打回、重复 blocking 三条）
- [ ] 园丁定时任务可创建并跑出票（集成测试）
- [ ] 用一次真实或合成误判跑通「纠正 → 新闸 → 负对照红 → 修复后绿」，记录进 `docs/verify/<票号>/`
- [ ] lint / typecheck / spec:parse / vitest related / e2e:affected 通过

issues.title: ops: 自举闭环 P7 长期宿主自部署与回滚（待宿主）
issues.body:
## 现状

pacman 合进 main 的是它自己的 server / daemon 代码，但长期运行的实例不会自动更新；一旦更新把 daemon 砸坏，它也修不了自己。没有部署脚本、没有最后已知良好版本、没有回滚。

当前采用 spec 28 §7.4 云端变体：施工在 Claude Code 云端会话里做，容器闲置即回收，不能当长期宿主。本票等用户选定长期宿主（mea / omarchy / 云服务器）后再开工。spec 28 P7（随 #1401 进 main）。

## 范围

- `scripts/ops/deploy-<宿主>.sh`：入参为 main 上的 SHA；校验必需检查全绿 → `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` → 构建 web → 按 `docs/ops-db-backup.md` 备份库 → 排空在飞步（有上限）→ 重启 systemd 单元 → 健康检查（server API、daemon 心跳、演练项目冒烟卡）→ 失败回滚到最后已知良好 SHA → 记部署行。
- systemd 定时器每 30 分钟挑「main 上必需检查全绿的最新 SHA」，与合并执行器解耦。
- 含迁移的版本：迁移是 D4 保护路径（人合），部署前强制备份。
- npm 发布永远留人。

## 失败方式

- 部署砸坏 daemon：回滚由脚本自己做，不依赖 pacman。
- 排空等不完：超时放弃本轮，不硬杀。
- 回滚目标本身也坏：停在原版本并通知。
- 部署检出与施工 worktree 混用：部署用独立检出目录。

## 验收

- [ ] 宿主选定并记入 spec 28 §3
- [ ] 演一次故意失败的部署，自动回滚，证据进 `docs/verify/<票号>/`
- [ ] 正常部署一次，健康检查全过

## Plan

Issue #1408 and spec 28 §7.4 explicitly defer implementation until a permanent host is selected (observed via `gh issue view 1408 -R xiechimon/cairn` and local spec). Keep host deployment blocked until that decision.

### Files and functions

Existing paths:
- `docs/spec/28-bootstrap-closed-loop-self-authored-self-merged.md`: update §3 host decision, P7 configuration and §8 evidence.
- `docs/ops-db-backup.md`: document host-specific backup, recovery and deployment procedures.
- `scripts/ops/backup-server-db.sh`: reuse its backup entry point; require successful backup before activation.
- `apps/daemon/src/machine-loop.ts`: extend `runMachine()` and `MachineHandle` with reversible draining; preserve presence and active-step heartbeats.
- `apps/server/src/services/merge-gate/github-facts.ts`: reference `projectBranch()`, `readRules()`, `pickRuns()` and `pickStatuses()` for required-check semantics; avoid coupling deployment to PR-specific facts.

Proposed additions, explicitly absent today:
- `scripts/ops/deploy-<host>.sh`: host entry point and deployment/rollback orchestration.
- `scripts/ops/systemd/cairn-deploy.service` and `cairn-deploy.timer`: independent deployment loop.
- `scripts/ops/deploy.test.mjs`: executable deployment failure harness.
- `docs/verify/1408/`: deployment transcripts and recovery evidence.

### Failing test first

Write a process-level test invoking the proposed deploy entry point against temporary Git releases and controlled service/health commands: candidate activation succeeds, daemon health fails, the independent deploy process restores the previous release, verifies recovery, leaves last-known-good unchanged and records failure. Initially fail because deployment is absent.

### Numbered steps

1. Record the selected host, actual service names, runtime commands, data paths, notification destination and rehearsal project. Confirm Linux/systemd compatibility; do not assume mea.
2. Enumerate failure cases before implementation: invalid/non-main SHA, unreadable/missing/pending/failed checks, overlapping runs, install/build/backup failure, drain timeout, interrupted activation, stale presence, smoke failure and failed rollback.
3. Add failing harness cases for these boundaries. Follow the temporary-repository/process-testing pattern in `scripts/gardener-weekly.test.mjs`.
4. Implement exact-SHA eligibility using current main ancestry and required checks, including rulesets, pagination, latest attempts and required GitHub App identity; fail closed when facts are incomplete.
5. Prepare immutable releases in a deployment-only checkout. Install frozen dependencies with lifecycle scripts disabled unless explicitly authorized; build web using the existing package command. Serialize deployments with a host lock.
6. Add reversible drain control to `runMachine()`: stop new claims, settle any outstanding claim safely, continue running steps and uploads, and acknowledge quiescence. On timeout resume claiming and abandon deployment without restarting services.
7. Back up before activation; account for writes completed during draining by taking a final backup after quiescence. Persist previous/current/last-known-good release pointers atomically outside release directories.
8. Activate and restart the configured services. Require authenticated server API success, fresh daemon presence after restart and a completed rehearsal smoke card before promoting last-known-good.
9. On failure restore the prior release independently of Cairn. Verify rollback; if recovery also fails, retain artifacts, stop retry loops and notify. Define migration compatibility and database restoration policy before enabling migration-bearing releases.
10. Install the 30-minute timer to select the newest eligible main SHA, skip already deployed releases and append deployment records. Keep npm publishing manual.

### Prior art

Known comparable projects; no external repository search performed:
- [systemd](https://github.com/systemd/systemd): reuse timers, service supervision and journal records.
- [Capistrano](https://github.com/capistrano/capistrano): adopt immutable-release/current-pointer conventions; build Cairn-specific checks and draining without adding Ruby infrastructure.

### Risks and verification

- Inference from `runMachine()`: existing `stop()` also disables presence and push handling, so it cannot serve as reversible draining unchanged.
- Migration rollback can invalidate old binaries or lose newer writes; a backup alone does not prove safe recovery.
- Run the failure harness, affected daemon tests, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm spec:parse`; use targeted package builds rather than root `pnpm build`.
- On the selected host, demonstrate drain timeout without termination, one deliberately failed deployment with verified rollback, and one successful deployment passing all three health checks. Archive SHA-bound logs, backup integrity results, timer status and deployment records under `docs/verify/1408/`.

Before implementing, run the new tests, confirm they fail for the stated reason, and paste that red output into the PR's Verified section. A test that cannot fail on main proves nothing.

Tier is hard: `scripts/**` is protected, and a broken deploy takes down the instance that runs every lane. The host is decided: **omarchy** (the owner's 10-27 rule, all decisions follow the recommendation; the Cairn server already runs there). Record that in spec 28 §3 / §7.4 in this PR, replacing "mea" and "pending host".

### First step, before writing code
On omarchy, record how Cairn runs today, in `docs/verify/1408/current-layout.md`:
- the unit names (`systemctl --user list-units 'cairn*'` and the system-level equivalent);
- the checkout or install path each unit runs from;
- the db path;
- the ports;
- whether the daemon runs from the same checkout.

The script is written against that measured layout, not against spec 28's mea wording. If the server runs from a lane worktree or the main development checkout, stop and report it. Deploys need their own checkout (failure mode 4 in the issue).

### Files
- `scripts/ops/deploy-omarchy.sh`. Input: a full SHA on `main`. It runs these steps in order, and each one fails loudly:
  1. Check that every required check on that SHA is green (`gh api repos/xiechimon/cairn/commits/<sha>/check-runs`, required set from branch protection).
  2. `git -C <deploy checkout> fetch && checkout --detach <sha>`, then `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and build the server bundle and web dist.
  3. Back up the db with `scripts/ops/backup-server-db.sh` (always, and refuse to continue on failure).
  4. Drain: set the server to stop handing out new claims through an existing admin path if one exists. If none exists, add the smallest one and list it in Risk. Wait for in-flight steps up to `--drain-timeout` (default 15 min). On timeout, abort this deploy without killing anything.
  5. Restart the units.
  6. Health checks:
     - the server API answers;
     - each daemon heartbeat is newer than the restart;
     - one smoke card on a rehearsal project reaches `confirm` within the timeout.
  7. On any health failure, roll back to `last-good` (same steps, no new backup) and notify. If the rollback's health check also fails, stop, leave it as is, and notify.
  8. Append one line `{at, sha, from, result, durationS}` to the deploy log, and update `last-good` on success.
- `scripts/ops/systemd/cairn-deploy.service` + `cairn-deploy.timer` (every 30 min). The timer picks the newest `main` SHA with all required checks green that differs from `last-good`.
- `docs/ops/deploy-omarchy.md`: the layout, the manual rollback command, and where the log is.
- No npm publishing anywhere in this path.

### Failing tests first
`scripts/ops/deploy-omarchy.test.mjs`, which drives the script with stub `git`, `pnpm`, `systemctl`, `curl` and `gh` on `PATH` and a temp state dir:
- `a SHA with a red required check is refused before any checkout`.
- `a backup failure stops before restart`.
- `drain timeout aborts without restarting and leaves last-good unchanged`.
- `a failed health check triggers rollback to last-good and writes result rollback`.
- `a failing rollback stops and writes result stuck, without looping`.
- `a successful deploy updates last-good and appends one log line`.
- `the timer picker skips SHAs equal to last-good`.

Wire the test in all three places:
1. `selfTests`;
2. the prepush self-test path regex;
3. the `node --test` line in `ci.yml`.

### Acceptance commands
```sh
node --test scripts/ops/deploy-omarchy.test.mjs
shellcheck scripts/ops/deploy-omarchy.sh
```
On omarchy, record each of these in `docs/verify/1408/`, with log excerpts:
- one normal deploy, with all health checks passing;
- one deliberately failed deploy (a SHA built with a startup that exits non-zero), with the automatic rollback shown.

### Do not touch
- The server's claim logic beyond the minimal drain switch.
- Migrations.
- Other `scripts/ops` scripts, except calling `backup-server-db.sh`.

### Pitfalls
- The deploy checkout sharing a directory with lanes. A lane's `pnpm install` or `dist/` build then clobbers the running server.
- `systemctl restart` returning 0 does not mean the server is healthy; only the health checks decide.
- Migrations run on start. A rollback to an older SHA after a migration may fail to start. Restore the pre-deploy backup in that case, and test that path.

### Open questions
- None. Host decided per recommendation (ian 10-27 rule).

issues.title: web: 像素标记家族——列状态 / 运行指示 / 空态 / chief FAB 走 logo 的 16 格语汇（先 mockup）
issues.body:
Blocked-By: #1432

## 现状

产品的视觉语汇只有一枚标记：`apps/web/public/logo.svg` 是 16 格 `crispEdges` 像素 pac-man，侧栏按 1 格 = 1 CSS px 用 mask 渲染（`board/sidebar.tsx:414`）。它只在这一处出现。其余所有「状态」和「空」都用通用件表达：

- 看板四列状态图标是 lucide 的 `CircleDashed / Activity / CircleAlert / CircleCheck`（`board/board.tsx:153-156`），每个 shadcn 模板里都有这四个。
- 运行指示走 `loading-dev` 的 Atom 自旋件。
- `EmptyState`（`components/empty-state.tsx`）按 DESIGN.md「空态」条款用裸 lucide 24px 图标；源码 42 处「暂无」是灰字。
- chief FAB（`chief/chief-fab-icon.tsx`）用的是 dicebear 兜底头像。

结果是：产品读起来像 shadcn starter，而不是「它自己」。

对照 agentes.chat（2026-10-21 拆解）：它的描边图标与 lucide 风格接近，真正的识别度来自一组「像素件」，全部从同一份 agent 引擎取形取色：`PixelSpinner`（3×3 网格一颗亮格绕圈的运行指示）、`PixelDone` / `PixelStop`（步骤完成弹出一颗绿像素 / 停止方块）、`RunPixels`（历次运行画成抖动色柱）、`MemoryPixels`（像素书）、`AutonomyPixels`（小 agent 加问号气泡）。图标讲「这是什么按钮」，像素件讲「这个产品是谁」。

## 范围

1. 先出 mockup（HTML 原型，沿 `apps/web/docs/board-paper-r5.html` 做法）：以 logo.svg 的 16 格语汇定义一个「像素标记」家族，静态 SVG，`shape-rendering="crispEdges"`，颜色只取 token（`icon` / `ink-4` / `accent` / `running`）。首批四组：
   - 看板四列状态标记：待开始 / 执行中 / 待处理 / 已完成，替换 lucide 四圆。
   - 运行指示：pac-man 吃点或 3×3 像素绕圈，替换 loading-dev Atom（仍走 `spinner-breathe` 的 reduced-motion 静止律）。
   - 空态标记：EmptyState 的图标位换成像素标记，三列空态与资源页空态各一枚。
   - chief FAB 标记：与 #1429 的头像生成器同一语汇。
2. 用户实审定稿后施工：标记落 `apps/web/src/icons/pixel/`（生成或手写 SVG 组件），消费点只换图标位，不动布局。
3. 同 PR 修订 `apps/web/DESIGN.md` 的「图标」与「空态」两条：lucide 继续承担 chrome（箭头、搜索、关闭），产品名词与状态改走像素标记；「给 agent 的美学约束」粘贴块同步。
4. 顺手过一遍 42 处「暂无」，空态文案按页改成具体一句（说明为什么空、下一步做什么）。

## 不在范围

- 不引入 canvas / rAF / 抖动动画；运行指示只允许 CSS keyframe 且受 reduced-motion 律约束。
- 不换 lucide 整套，不动 registry 件。
- logo 本身与产品名不在本票（另议）。

## 验收

- mockup 经用户确认后才改代码。
- 对比度实测（非文本 3:1）双模；标记在 12 / 14 / 16 / 24 四档尺寸下像素对齐截图。
- fixture 两态截图 + live 真点击截图进 `docs/verify/<票号>/`；probe-dump 三方 diff 登记 intended re-pin。
- `pnpm lint` / `pnpm typecheck` / `pnpm spec:parse` 绿，`e2e:affected` 绿。

issues.title: 决议：品牌——产品名候选 + 标记重设计 + 改名迁移清单（#1429 / #1431 前置）
issues.body:
Blocks: #1429, #1431（两票的头像与状态标记都从本票定下的标记长出来；本票拿到结论前它们只做调研不施工）

## 现状

产品名「pacman」和 `apps/web/public/logo.svg` 的吃豆人标记是 #44 / #109 素材替换期定下的过渡名，#44 票面明写「产品名与域名候选，不复用 todos.dev 名字发布」，`packages/shared/src/brand.ts` 的 `BRAND_SLOTS` 就是为一次性改名准备的单点。到今天它还没换，而对外面已经漏出去了：

- **商标**：PAC-MAN 是 Bandai Namco 的注册商标（Justia：Reg. 1259524、1260102）。标记画的就是那个角色。
- **可发现性**：对开发者 pacman = Arch Linux 包管理器；npm 上 `pacman` 是静态站生成器、`pacman-cli` 已被占，仓内包只能躲在 `@xiechimon/` 作用域；GitHub 搜索全是游戏复刻。
- **隐喻**：产品核心是「人下任务、agent 执行、计划与 diff 两道闸」，吃豆人隐喻与此无关。
- **标记无法长出家族**：现标记没有眼睛，不能承担 agent 的脸与状态（思考 / 等你批准 / 完成）；只在 16px 成立，README 128px 处已经粗糙。#1429（本地像素头像）与 #1431（像素标记家族）都需要一个能当 agent 的源标记。
- **已对外**：npm 已发 `@xiechimon/pacman` 与 `@xiechimon/pacman-cli` 0.1.x；GitHub 仓名；Conduid 的 kanban MCP 列表已收录 "Pacman"；用户机器上有 `~/.pacman`、`PACMAN_*` 环境变量、`pacman_` 前缀 API 密钥、`pacman/conv-` 分支。

对照 agentes.chat（2026-10-21 拆解）：名字本身说产品（agentes = agents，.chat = 它住的地方）；标记就是 agent 的身体，logo / favicon / 头像 / 精灵一家人。

## 范围

### 1. 产品名候选（本票 resolution 评论给表，用户拍板）

- 约束：中英文都能念、能当 CLI 命令名与 env 前缀、不与现有开发者工具撞名、能对应一个有眼睛的像素小生物。
- 四项查重，每个候选逐项填表：npm 无作用域包名是否空闲（`registry.npmjs.org/<name>`）、GitHub 同名仓热度、域名（.dev / .app / .chat 任一）、商标（USPTO TESS 第 9 / 42 类 + 中国商标网同类）。
- 产出 5–8 个候选的评分表，附每个名字的一句话隐喻。

### 2. 标记重设计（先 mockup，用户实审）

- 一个有眼睛的像素小生物，沿用 16 格 `crispEdges` 语汇与赭红 `accent`，设计成「总管」本身：侧栏品牌位、chief FAB、agent 头像的源形。
- 状态词汇：idle / thinking / waiting（等你批准）/ done 四态的眼睛或姿态变化，静态 SVG。
- 尺寸：16 / 24 / 32 / 128 / 512 五档像素对齐，明暗两版，maskable 版本；输出走现有 `scripts/generate-app-icons.mjs` 管线。
- mockup 载体：HTML 原型（沿 `apps/web/docs/board-paper-r5.html` 做法），覆盖侧栏、README 头图、浏览器 tab、PWA 图标、chief FAB 五个位置。

### 3. 改名迁移清单（本票只列清单，执行另开票）

- 单点：`packages/shared/src/brand.ts` `BRAND_SLOTS`（CLI 命令名、`PACMAN_` 前缀、`~/.pacman`、`pacman/conv-`、`pacman_` 密钥前缀、包名）。
- 机械面：`apps/web/src` 68 个文件、i18n 文案 13 处、README / README.zh、`manifest.webmanifest`、`index.html` 标题。
- 对外迁移期（至少一个版本）：npm 新名发布 + 旧包 `npm deprecate` 指向新包；`~/.pacman` 自动搬家到新目录；`pacman_` 密钥前缀与 `PACMAN_*` 环境变量双读；GitHub 仓改名（旧名自动跳转）；Conduid 等收录处更新。
- 分支前缀 `pacman/conv-`：存量分支不动，新分支用新前缀。

## 不在范围

- #1429 / #1431 的施工（它们等本票结论）。
- 改名执行本身（清单定稿后另开执行票，按 brand.ts 单点 + 迁移期双读施工）。
- 色板与 Paper 方向不动。

## 验收

- 用户在 resolution 评论里拍板一个名字与一个标记方案。
- 标记 mockup 五个位置截图经实审确认。
- 迁移清单逐项带文件路径，执行票可直接照单开工。
- 解除 #1429 / #1431 的阻塞。

## 要做
- 从 `closes #N` 的已合并 PR 中筛题：PR 自带测试、改动规模适中、合并于主力模型知识截止之后。题干 = issue 原文 + base sha；答案 = PR 中的测试（对 agent 隐藏）。

## 验收
- 30 题清单 + 每题 oracle 自检记录；ian 抽看约 10 题确认「两个专家会给同一判定」。

## Acceptance checklist (tier: hard)

Writer: codex, tests first. Reviewer: glm (other vendor); Claude spot-checks in the thread.
This list adds files, test names, commands and limits to the issue body. It does not replace the issue's Acceptance; both must hold.
Before implementing, run the new tests, confirm they fail for the stated reason, and paste that red output into the PR's Verified section. A test that cannot fail on main proves nothing.

Tier is hard: `integration/eval/**` is a D4 protected path (ADR 0025). The task set becomes a ruler later PRs are judged by.

Owner's decision (2026-10-27, option recommended):
- an agent picks the 30 PRs;
- two labelers from different vendors check each task;
- the owner spot-checks about 5.

No other human gate.

### Files
- `integration/eval/harbor/pr-to-task.py` (new, uv script, run with `uv run --with harbor==0.25.0` or a pinned `pyproject.toml`). It takes `--pr N` and writes one Harbor task dir:
  - `instruction.md` = the linked issue's body, verbatim, fenced as data;
  - `environment/Dockerfile` = Cairn at the PR's base sha with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` run at build time;
  - `tests/` = the PR's added or changed test files plus a `test.sh` that runs only them;
  - `solution/solve.sh` = `git apply` of the PR's non-test diff.
- `integration/eval/harbor/tasks/bench-v0/<pr>/`: 30 task dirs.
- `integration/eval/harbor/bench-v0.json`, with one entry per task:
  - `pr`;
  - `issue`;
  - `baseSha`;
  - `partition` (`optimize` | `holdout`, fixed by `issue % 2`, written once and never recomputed);
  - `oracle` (pass/fail and log path);
  - `nop` (fail expected);
  - `labels` (two labeler verdicts, with model and vendor);
  - `kept`.
- `integration/eval/harbor/bench-v0.md`: selection rules, the rejected candidates with reasons, and the 5 tasks for the owner's spot-check.

### Selection rules (encode them in the script and apply them; do not hand-pick)
- The PR is merged, its commit message has `closes #N`, it adds or changes at least one test, and its non-test diff is 20-400 lines.
- Exclusions:
  - PRs whose tests are e2e (playwright) or need network;
  - PRs that touch `integration/eval/**`, migrations only, or docs only.
- Merged on or after 2026-07-01, so it is after the main models' training data.

### Failing tests first
`integration/eval/harbor/test_pr_to_task.py` (pytest), on a fixture PR diff, checks that:
- test files go only to `tests/`;
- the instruction contains no diff hunk;
- `solution/` contains no test file;
- the Dockerfile pins the base sha.

`integration/test/bench-v0-manifest.test.ts` checks that:
- the manifest has 30 kept tasks;
- partitions are about half and half;
- every kept task has `oracle: pass`, `nop: fail` and two agreeing labels from two different vendors;
- no kept task's `tests/` is referenced from its `instruction.md`.

Before implementing, run both and paste the red output.

### Acceptance commands
```sh
uv run --with pytest pytest integration/eval/harbor/test_pr_to_task.py
pnpm --filter @cairn/integration exec vitest run test/bench-v0-manifest.test.ts
# on omarchy, per task (record wall time and disk in bench-v0.md):
uv tool run --from harbor==0.25.0 harbor run -p integration/eval/harbor/tasks/bench-v0/<pr> -a oracle
uv tool run --from harbor==0.25.0 harbor run -p integration/eval/harbor/tasks/bench-v0/<pr> -a nop   # if the pinned Harbor has no nop agent, add a do-nothing agent class next to the script
```

### Do not touch
- `integration/eval/chief-dispatch/**` (the 64-case regression gate).
- `adoption/judge.mts`.
- Any baseline or allowlist file.
- Do not run any non-oracle agent on the holdout partition in this PR.

### Pitfalls
- Task containers on omarchy have no working network in the default Docker bridge (#1681), and scoring must be offline anyway: bake every test dependency into the image at build time. A task whose oracle passes only with `--network host` is not kept.
- Copying the whole PR diff into `solution/` and also its tests into `tests/` is right. Copying tests into the environment image leaks the answer: the image must not contain the PR's test files.
- Labelers must see the instruction and the hidden tests, not the solution, and answer "would two experts accept these tests as the judge of this instruction". Dropping disagreements is the rule. Do not re-ask a model until it agrees.
- Fewer than 30 tasks surviving is a valid outcome: report the count and the reasons, and do not loosen the rules to reach 30.

### Open questions
- None. The cost is free channels only (labelers on glm and a non-Zhipu vendor). Running the oracle and nop agents needs no model.

issues.body:
背景：#1510 评测闭环的「基线对比层」。目的：同模型、同提示词，只换 harness（pacman / Claude Code CLI / 裸 pi 循环），比谁做出的页面更好。「训练」只指优化 harness，不微调模型。

## 设计要点
- 只变 harness，其余锁死：模型、提示词、时间与 token 上限一致。对照组三个：pacman、Claude Code CLI、裸 pi 循环（用来区分提升来自 harness 还是多花了 token）。
- 强弱两档模型都测。弱档候选 glm-5.3-flash / deepseek-v4.1-flash，强档候选 glm-5.3（均 1M 上下文；不用 MiniMax M3）。待 ian 确认。
- 8 到 10 道页面题，类型拉开（落地页、仪表盘、表单、交互小工具等）；每题每个 harness 跑 3 到 5 次。
- 打分三层：
  1. 机器判：能否构建、控制台无报错、Playwright 截图、需求清单逐条断言。
  2. 盲评：截图打乱顺序，强模型按固定细则成对比较，正反顺序各评一次。
  3. 人抽查：ian 每批盲看若干组，校准模型评分。
- 同时记录耗时、token、重试次数，报告「单位成本质量」。
- 题库与打分细则放 `integration/eval/**`，属 ADR 0022 保护路径，agent 不能改自己的尺子。

## 分步
- 现在做：写题库 + 打分细则（纯文档与脚本骨架）；用裸 pi 循环在弱档跑一轮，验证题目难度与打分是否靠谱。
- 等 #1511–#1514 合并、自举闭环跑通后：跑 pacman 与 Claude Code CLI 的正式对比，并和「开发完善前」的基线再比一次。

## 待确认
- 模型选择（见上）。
- Claude Code CLI 能否接公司中转的模型；接不上则对照组换其他开源 CLI harness。

依赖：#1510（spec 29 / ADR 0022）、#1514。

issues.title: 错误台账 L1：pnpm prepush 一键闸 + AGENTS.md 台账规则 + 纠错触发补 ci-fix 转绿
issues.body:
依据：ian 2026-10-22 确认的方案「过程错误复盘机制」，全文见项目文件 lessons-loop/design.md。台账在 `docs/lessons.md`（L0 已建）。

## 现状

推送前要手动记着跑 lint、typecheck、spec:parse、ui-debt-gate、ui-dead-class-gate 和受影响的 e2e。PR #1523 就因为漏跑两道 UI 闸红了两轮。靠记忆提醒是台账里最软的一层。#1407 的纠错触发只有回滚、打回、同类 blocking 重复三种，没有「ci-fix 后转绿」。

## 要做

1. 仓里加 `pnpm prepush`：一条命令按改动面跑齐上面这些检查（只改文档时跳过代码类检查）；CI 的对应步骤调用同一条命令，不再各写一份。
2. AGENTS.md 加一小节「错误台账」：任何 agent 在任务中犯错并修好后，当轮往 `docs/lessons.md` 加一行或更新已有行，并按阶梯取最高可行级；新闸必须拿真实失误做负对照。
3. 在 #1407 的纠错触发里补一条：build 经过 ci-fix 且最终转绿，也算一次待归因事件，按类别去重后开 `correction` 票。
4. 派给 pi、grok、codex 的提示带上 AGENTS.md 的台账规则（与 #1520 的派活提示改动合并做，避免两次改）。

## 失败方式

- prepush 与 CI 各跑各的，慢慢漂移：CI 直接调同一条命令，自检断言两处一致。
- 只改文档也被迫跑全套：按改动路径分流。
- 台账被各 lane 并行改，冲突：一类错一行，冲突时按类别合并。

## 验收

- [ ] 故意漏掉一处 UI 违规（如 `mt-[3px]`），`pnpm prepush` 变红；改正后变绿
- [ ] CI 调用的就是 `pnpm prepush`
- [ ] AGENTS.md 有台账规则
- [ ] ci-fix 转绿触发开 `correction` 票的集成测试，同类去重
- [ ] lint / typecheck / spec:parse / vitest --changed 通过

关联 #1407、#1515。

## Plan

Observed: #1534 requires L2 first; `.claude/workflow.md` identifies L2 as #1535. This checkout has ledger validation and gardener reporting, but no identified L2 event producer. Confirm that integration contract before implementation.

### Files and functions
- `scripts/lessons-ledger-gate.mjs`: extend `parseEntry`, `checkEntry`, `checkLedgerRoot`, and `renderTable` for stable category identifiers and script-maintained counters; add exported event-reduction and weekly-summary functions.
- `scripts/lessons-ledger-gate.test.mjs`: add event replay, category matching, escalation, and counter-integrity coverage.
- `scripts/prepush.mjs`: extend `runPlan` to capture structured safeguard failures without changing their exit status; update `prepushPlan` if additional checks are needed.
- `scripts/prepush.test.mjs`: cover failure recording and preserved failure behavior.
- `scripts/gardener-weekly.mjs`: extend the CLI report assembly with lesson totals and safeguards awaiting evaluation.
- `scripts/gardener-weekly.test.mjs`: test empty data, normal activity, inactivity thresholds, and weekly boundaries.
- `.github/workflows/gardener-weekly.yml`: load durable event history and publish the combined report; isolate any issue-creation permission from untrusted PR execution.
- `docs/lessons/README.md`: document category keys, automated counters, event identity, inactivity policy, and migration.
- `docs/spec/29-evaluation-and-data-loop.md`: reconcile the integration contract; observed: this document says #1515’s weekly summary was replaced by Langfuse dashboards.

### Failing test first
In `scripts/lessons-ledger-gate.test.mjs`, replay one structured gate failure twice for the same repository, PR, category, gate, and failure episode: assert `Intercepts` increases exactly once. A distinct episode must increase it again.

### Numbered steps
1. Define failure modes before implementation: duplicate delivery, concurrent writes, ambiguous categories, missing history, pre-safeguard events, failed issue creation, and incomplete weekly inputs.
2. Establish L2’s structured event contract. Use explicit category keys and safeguard activation timestamps; reject unknown or ambiguous matches instead of matching symptom prose.
3. Define durable event storage and stable episode identifiers shared by local and CI producers. Preserve existing ledger counts as a migration baseline rather than resetting history.
4. Implement idempotent event reduction and counter projection. Validate manual counter changes against the baseline and recorded events.
5. Connect `runPlan` failures and L2 recurrence events. Count a blocked attempt as an interception; count an escaped same-category error after safeguard activation as a recurrence.
6. Implement retryable escalation with a durable deduplication marker and recorded issue number. Suggest a stronger safeguard; flag level-1 cases for review because no higher rung exists.
7. Generate deterministic weekly totals for new categories, interceptions, and recurrences. Mark safeguards awaiting evaluation after a configurable number of complete inactive weeks; never delete them.
8. Include those results in gardener reporting and the evaluation reporting destination confirmed in step 1; document any remaining dependency explicitly.

### Prior art
- [Danger JS](https://github.com/danger/danger-js): build the domain logic locally; its PR automation model is comparable, but does not supply this ledger’s event semantics.
- [reviewdog](https://github.com/reviewdog/reviewdog): reuse the structured-diagnostic approach, without adding a dependency solely for counters.
- [Probot](https://github.com/probot/probot): defer reuse; a separate GitHub App adds operational scope beyond the existing scripts and workflow.

### Risks
- Inference: exit codes alone cannot identify lesson categories; safeguards need explicit mappings or structured diagnostics.
- Concurrent runs and interrupted issue creation can duplicate counts or tickets unless persistence and retries are idempotent.
- Missing telemetry must mean “unknown,” not zero activity; inactivity thresholds remain a policy choice.
- Issue creation requires trusted credentials and must not execute PR-controlled code with write permissions.

### How to verify
- Run the four affected Node test files; exercise the CLI in temporary repositories with empty, normal, duplicate, concurrent, and malformed inputs.
- Use a fake GitHub command to prove one escalation request across retries; separately validate a real issue response in an authorized sandbox.
- Inspect generated ledger counters and weekly artifacts, including exact week boundaries and evaluation-report integration.
- Run `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm spec:parse`, and `pnpm prepush`; do not run `pnpm build`.

### The data problem, and the design call made here
"A gate red counts as one intercept" needs a record of gate reds. None exists:
- `runPlan` in `scripts/prepush.mjs` exits on the first failing command and logs nothing structured;
- most gates are in `localOnly`, so they never run in CI, and CI logs alone would miss them;
- a lesson file has no machine link to the gate that guards it.

Design (reviewer: hold the PR to it):
1. **Red log.** `runPlan` appends one JSON line, `{at, gate, branch, headSha, mode}`, to the file named by `CAIRN_GATE_LOG` when that variable is set, and only for the command that failed. It writes nothing when the variable is unset (the default, so humans' machines are untouched). CI sets it and uploads the file as artifact `gate-reds`. The omarchy lane runner sets it to one shared file; that change is in omarchy tooling, so note it in the PR, not in the repo.
2. **Gate link.** `docs/lessons/gate-map.json` is `{ "<gate command, e.g. scripts/comment-discipline-gate.mjs>": ["<lesson file>", ...] }`. The ledger gate validates it:
   - every key is a gate that `prepushPlan` can run;
   - every value is an existing lesson file at Level 1 or 2.

   The seven-field lesson format does not change.
3. **Weekly job.** `scripts/lessons-weekly.mjs` runs in `.github/workflows/gardener-weekly.yml`. It reads the last 7 days of `gate-reds` artifacts, plus the omarchy file when given `--log`. It dedupes by `(branch, gate)`, so one PR's repeated reds of one gate count once, then maps the reds to lessons. Its outputs:
   - (a) a summary section: new lesson files this week, intercepts per lesson, recurrences that increased, and safeguards with 0 intercepts and 0 recurrences for 4 weeks marked "to evaluate". These are listed only, never deleted.
   - (b) one PR that updates the `Intercepts:` field of each affected lesson file.
   - (c) for each lesson whose `Recurrences:` went up in the week's merged commits, one issue proposing the next rung up. Before opening it, search for an existing open issue that names that lesson file.

### Files
- `scripts/prepush.mjs` (`runPlan`).
- `scripts/lessons-ledger-gate.mjs`.
- `scripts/lessons-weekly.mjs` (new).
- `docs/lessons/gate-map.json` (new). Map at least the existing Level-2 entries whose safeguard names a script gate.

issues.title: 错误台账：按「codebase→静态检查→规则→技能→人审」五级阶梯定级与升级（poteto 纠错阶梯）
issues.body:
## 背景

ian 认定 pacman 的自进化理念来自 poteto（Lauren Tan）置顶视频里那张幻灯片：https://x.com/poteto/status/2102050467505430555 （约 15:35 和 36:12 处）。标题是「每当你纠正 agent 时」，五级按强到弱排序（幻灯片原文）：

1. codebase
2. static analysis（lint / 编译器 / CI）
3. rules / bugbot
4. skills
5. "style guide"

要点（字幕转述）：同一个错要往最强的一级堵。第 1 级是把代码结构改到这个错写不出来；第 2 级是 lint/CI 硬约束；第 3、4 级只是引导，agent 可能不照做；第 5 级只有人审能执行。她没有用「自进化」一词，「一层层叠加」是我们的解读。不走 Hermes 那种把纠正写进记忆的路线，记忆是最后手段。

## 现状对照

| 级 | pacman 现状 | 缺口 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 codebase | 无系统化机制 | 纠错时没有「改结构让错误不可能」的固定动作和检查 |
| 2 静态检查 | 已有 lint、typecheck、spec:parse、ui-debt-gate、ui-dead-class-gate | 推送前无统一入口，#1533 `pnpm prepush` 待做 |
| 3 规则/自动审核 | AGENTS.md 规则已有 | 合并就绪闸 #1404 待做 |
| 4 skills | 技能库已有 | correct skill #1407 待做 |
| 5 人审 | 有 | 人审反馈结构化落库 #1513 待做 |

## 要做

不重复已有票，只补「阶梯」这条主线：

1. 在 `docs/lessons.md` 台账里给每条错误记「落在第几级」，并把上面五级写成统一标尺，AGENTS.md 台账规则引用它（与 #1533 合并做，避免改两次 AGENTS.md）。
2. #1535（从轨迹检测出错又修好）产出候选防护时，必须标出可行的最高级，并说明为什么不能再高一级。
3. #1534（复发自动升级）把「升级」定义为沿这五级往强的方向挪，不是多写一条记忆。
4. 补第 1 级的缺口：纠错票模板加一问「能否改结构让它不可能？」，答否要写理由。

## 验收

- [ ] 台账每行有级别字段，lint 或脚本检查缺失即红
- [ ] #1535 / #1534 的票面验收引用本阶梯
- [ ] 纠错票模板含第 1 级一问

关联 #1533 #1534 #1535 #1536 #1407 #1404 #1513 #1405。动 AGENTS.md 属 ADR 0021 D4 保护路径，合并留人。

## 现状

`scripts/single-use-helper-gate.mjs` 的白名单要求 `declaration` 与被标记函数的整段源码逐字相等。改动碰到一个很大的既有函数的任意一行（例如 #1560 给 `runClaimedStep` 加了一个参数），闸就会标红，而白名单要放行就得把上千行函数体整段写进 JSON，之后函数每改一次都要重写。

## 要做

- 白名单改为按 `path` + `name` + `reason` 匹配，不再要求整段声明文本。

## 失败方式

- 放宽后漏掉真正新增的单次使用函数：保留现有的新增函数负对照测试。
- 白名单条目被滥用：每条必须带 reason，且 name 必须在当前文件里存在，否则闸报错。

issues.title: RSI-2 用现成 GEPA 跑一轮提示词自动优化，变体与分数（含失败）全部存档
issues.body:
## 问题

现在的 harness 优化是人（Claude 线程）读失败轨迹、改提示词、重跑评测：chief-dispatch 的名字与 id 错位就是这样从 80% 修到 100%（`.claude/hillclimb/chief-dispatch/metrics.md`）。这条路有效，但每一轮都要人；优化器本身没有被自动化，也没有把试过又失败的变体留下来。

## 方案（不造轮子：用 GEPA，不自己写搜索器）

GEPA（Genetic-Pareto，DSPy 团队开源，`pip install gepa`）读失败轨迹、用自然语言反思改写提示词，在多目标上保留帕累托前沿。它支持自定义适配器，Cairn 只需要写一个适配器把候选提示词交给现有的 TS runner：

1. 适配器：候选文本 → 写进评测种子的提示词覆盖 → 调 `integration/eval/chief-dispatch/run-eval.mts`（小样本档）→ 回传分数与失败轨迹摘要。
2. 优化对象先只开一个：总管的派工规则段落。chief-dispatch 已饱和，目标集用 E2 的 pacman-bench（#1517–#1519），chief-dispatch 作回归门。
3. 存档：每个变体的文本、分数、成本、失败原因落 `.claude/hillclimb/<flow>/variants/`，失败的也留（DGM 的存档思路，也对应 Weng 说的「负结果难留」）。
4. 产出只是候选 PR，走 RSI-1 的评测门和人审，不直接改产品代码。

## 失败方式

- 过拟合优化集：optimize / holdout 拆分（#1517 已规划），只看 holdout 涨幅。
- 改出很长的提示词把成本推高：成本作为第二目标进帕累托。
- 评测器被优化器利用：评测代码与用例在 D4 保护路径下，适配器只能写提示词覆盖。

## 参考

- GEPA：https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.19457
- Darwin Gödel Machine：https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.22954
comments:
参考资料补充（2026-10-26 雷达复核，原文已读）：

**Harness²**（论文 https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14224 ，代码 https://github.com/google-research/harness2 ，Northwestern + Google Cloud AI Research，README 注明不是 Google 官方产品）
- 不改权重，两层循环：任务内 Propose–Probe–Compose（一个通用候选 + 一个领域候选，各跑一遍，对比轨迹，合并或放弃）；任务间把采纳的 harness 整棵树 + `EXPERIENCE.md`（适用场景、教训、证据）存进按领域分的经验库，证据不足就不入库。
- 可改的面有 8 个：system prompt、guardrails、memory、tool guidance、subagents、skills、scripts、plugins。
- 数据：GLM-5 + OpenCode 在 WorkBuddy-Bench 64.2 → 75.7（+11.5，一步优化），Gemini 3.5 Flash 72.4 → 77.5（+5.1）。改 harness 的编辑者是 Claude Opus 4.8。
- **它采纳改动时没有留出集、没有回归闸**，论文自己承认「轨迹对比不验证正确性」，附录列了 9 个退步案例（如 LAB 54 → 26）。

**对照研究**（https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30499 ，ARC-AGI-3）：模型自己重写 harness 两次，留出集平均只涨 2.80 分且 95% 区间跨零；开发集涨幅高估留出集；省成本的改写常常掉分。

结论：E3 可以借 Harness² 的「候选生成 + 经验库存可执行补丁」的形状，但采纳必须继续走 #1605 的配对判定 + 留出集，这正是它缺的那一环；不要因为它的 +11.5 跳过 E2。

## Candidate variant: write the judging criteria first (2026-10-26)

Add one hand-written seed variant to the first GEPA run, so the optimizer starts from it and the archive records whether it helps:

Before acting, the agent writes four short lists into its plan: (1) what kind of practitioner normally does this work and what they judge "good" by; (2) the most common beginner mistakes for this task; (3) where the task could be wrong at the root even after avoiding those mistakes (wrong goal, wrong premise, wrong success measure); (4) the highest-priority constraints distilled from 1 to 3.

Why as a variant and not a direct prompt edit: the evidence says the persona part does nothing on its own. Wharton GAIL tested expert personas on GPQA Diamond and MMLU-Pro across six models and found "expert personas don't improve factual accuracy"; most differences were not significant, and low-knowledge personas hurt. https://gail.wharton.upenn.edu/research-and-insights/playing-pretend-expert-personas/ The part that may help is spelling out criteria, which is exactly the kind of claim this ticket's archive should measure, including the case where it scores worse (extra tokens, longer plans).

Source of the prompt: @suyuan1711 on X, 2026-10-15 (relayed in the project chat).


---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

## Candidate variant: OpenCode's anti-overengineering rules (2026-10-26)

For when the optimization target widens from chief dispatch to the implementer prompt (`packages/shared/src/records/persona.ts`, role `implementer`). Source: OpenCode's AGENTS.md style guide, "General Principles" (https://github.com/sst/opencode/blob/dev/AGENTS.md), recommended on X as a cure for Codex writing defensive code for near-impossible cases.

Lines Cairn's rules do not already cover:

1. "Validate unknown values once at the boundary that owns them. Pass typed values inward ... Do not defensively revalidate values already guaranteed by a schema, constructor, or internal type."
2. "Before adding complexity for a speculative or vanishingly unlikely race or security edge case, explain the concrete failure mode, likelihood, and complexity cost ... Do not silently expand scope for theoretical robustness."
3. "Avoid try/catch where possible."

(No comments, inline single-use helpers, no `any` and no inline imports are already in CLAUDE.md.)

Adaptation: the implementer has no user to ask mid-run, so rule 2 becomes "write the unlikely case into the PR Risk section instead of adding code for it". It must not override the existing "list failure modes first" rule; together they read: list every failure mode, write code and tests for the likely ones, record the rest in Risk.

Scoring: same bench tasks, pass rate plus added lines and new branch / try count per diff; adopt only if holdout pass rate holds and diff size drops. Evidence on rules files is thin: compliance studies exist (arXiv 2606.12231, 2605.29442) but none measure task success, so this needs our own A/B.

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

Two additions from the "harness of harnesses" review (Raven Show HN thread and the Harness-of-Harness paper).

**1. Prune stale rules when the default model changes, not only add new ones.** A builder of a Claude Code meta-harness on the Raven thread: "when major new models come out it's weeks before I can find and fix constraints that are no longer necessary + constraints that have become necessary." https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49890647 GEPA mostly rewrites and grows prompts. Add one mutation type: drop one rule paragraph from the dispatch section and keep the variant if the holdout score is not worse and the prompt is shorter (cost is already the second Pareto objective). Trigger a pruning round whenever the roster's default model changes; #1777's weekly rerun detects that drift.

**2. Mutate how, keep the output contract fixed.** Harness-of-Harness (arXiv 2609.01481) constrains each role's structured output and retries on schema violations, but leaves the reasoning steps and tool order to the agent. For this ticket that means the adapter may rewrite guidance text, but the verdict and plan schemas the runtime parses (`reviewVerdictSchema`, `verifyVerdictSchema`, plan sections) are out of the optimizer's reach, same as the eval code under D4.

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

Split the optimizer's edits into two lanes: how-to-work (process) and domain knowledge. Keep repo facts separate from general practice, and do not put into the always-on prompt anything that can be a skill. Reference: Harness² INV/DOM templates and the GENERALIZE section.

mergedPulls.title: daemon(1744): recover message-shaped compaction summaries
mergedPulls.body:
## What

This is the message-shaped provider recovery stage for #1744. `compactionCeilingFetch` retries pi summary requests that exceed a provider context window. It lowers the output limit when enough room remains, or shortens conversation input within four attempts. Summary system and developer messages activate recovery. Ordinary requests pass through unchanged.

Enabled thinking retains its original budget. Every output rewrite reserves at least one token above that budget. A 4096-token thinking budget therefore keeps an output limit of at least 4097 instead of producing an invalid 512-token retry. The lessons use main's per-file ledger.

This delivery supersedes #1868. #1935 overlaps the earlier implementation and retains the boundary problems corrected here.

## Verified

The same wrapper-level controls failed before the thinking-budget fix and pass afterward:

```text
pnpm exec vitest run apps/daemon/test/pi-compaction-thinking-budget.test.ts
Before: Tests 2 failed | 1 passed (3)

pnpm exec vitest run apps/daemon/test/pi-compaction-ceiling.test.ts apps/daemon/test/pi-compaction-thinking-budget.test.ts
After: Tests 22 passed (22)
```

Actual output: [failing controls](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/66cde23b/docs/verify/1744/thinking-budget/red.log), [passing controls](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/66cde23b/docs/verify/1744/thinking-budget/green.log), and [serialized retry parameters](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/66cde23b/docs/verify/1744/thinking-budget/wire.json). The recorded generic-error replay keeps thinking enabled at 4096, lowers output from 8192 to 4097, and shortens input until the deterministic provider accepts it.

`pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, and `pnpm spec:parse` pass. Logs: [lint](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/66cde23b/docs/verify/1744/thinking-budget/lint.log), [types](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/66cde23b/docs/verify/1744/thinking-budget/typecheck.log), and [spec collection](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/66cde23b/docs/verify/1744/thinking-budget/spec-parse.log).

Earlier boundary controls remain recorded in [recovery review](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/e59ccc27/docs/verify/1744/recovery-review.md), [original failures](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/e59ccc27/docs/verify/1744/recovery-red.log), and [JSON failures](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/e59ccc27/docs/verify/1744/structure-red.log).

## Upstream

pi 1.4.0 estimates summary input and clamps output, but the provider can count more input tokens or reject the input itself. The wrapper handles actual HTTP 400/413 ceiling errors. The installed Anthropic SDK 0.129.0 requires enabled `budget_tokens` to be at least 1024 and strictly below `max_tokens`; output rewrites enforce that constraint. The upstream compaction reserve remains 16384.

## Risk

Two-way door. The affected behavior is summary HTTP retry and daemon compaction logging. Quoted-marker, malformed JSON, ordinary request, and non-ceiling error controls check the pass-through boundaries. Attempts are bounded at four and exhausted recovery returns the provider error.

These are deterministic request-level and upstream summary tests. A fresh real-provider deployment and complete production step survival remain unverified. Responses-shaped requests using `input` and `max_output_tokens` remain unchanged. Those remaining parts of #1744 are not accepted by this PR.

Historical commits contain parent-closing keywords. The audited [squash message](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/66cde23b/docs/verify/1744/thinking-budget/squash-message.txt) must be used explicitly. The [message guard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/66cde23b/docs/verify/1744/thinking-budget/check-merge-message.mjs) rejects the three historical closing keywords and accepts the audited message. Default aggregation of historical commit messages is unsuitable here.

## Acceptance

- [x] Message-shaped summary ceiling errors retry with bounded output fitting or input reduction, including oversized final blocks: 22 passing cases linked above.
- [x] Enabled thinking retains its budget and every rewritten output limit exceeds it: both reported-input and generic-error controls, plus serialized retry evidence.
- [x] Exhausted recovery logs the ceiling reason and returns the provider error: terminal-failure control in the original suite.
- [x] Ordinary requests and non-ceiling errors retain their behavior: quoted-marker, JSON boundary, and invalid-key controls.
- [x] This partial delivery leaves the parent issue open: audited squash message and its negative/positive controls linked above.

## Issues

Part of #1744. Production step survival and Responses-shaped recovery remain outstanding. The final squash message must use the audited text and leave #1744 open.

mergedPulls.title: server(1618): reproduce-first intake path with replay evidence
mergedPulls.body:
## What

Segment of #1618, the bug-ticket outer loop. PR #1647 gave `bug`-labeled GitHub issues a reproduce-first block in the orchestration prompt. This PR pins the wording of that block, covers the intake path with tests, and records a replay of two ticket payloads through the real intake code.

The prompt block from #1647 told the agent to change the issue to `ready-for-agent` on success. Intake only imports issues that already carry `ready-for-agent` (applied by a trusted human, D5), so that wording was a no-op, and the failure path never removed it. `buildOrchestratePrompt` in `packages/shared/src/records/prompts.ts` now names the commands: on success, reply with `gh issue comment` (screenshot and reproduce steps) and keep `ready-for-agent`; when the ticket cannot be reproduced or does not match the feature map, reply with candidate pages and attempted paths, then run `gh issue edit --add-label needs-info --remove-label ready-for-agent`. Issue text stays data: the block repeats that instructions inside the quoted ticket are not executed.

`apps/server/test/issue-intake.test.ts` gains describe 27 (#1618): 27a, an issue labeled `Bug` carries the block and an unlabeled one does not; 27b, edits and label toggles on the same issue never create a second card or chief thread (intake dedupes by issue number through `claimedRefs` and `importsInFlight`); 27c, instructions in the issue body stay behind the quote fence start. `packages/shared/test/issue-fence.test.ts` asserts the three command strings.

`docs/verify/1618/` records the replay of two payloads through `createIssueIntake` with a GitHub fake: the closed bug ticket #1728 and a synthetic thin ticket. Each produces one card and one chief thread whose message carries the reproduce-first block, with the ticket text inside the fence: [replay.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/33f09cfaa0b8754fb100fd9000e5e9139b143ec8/docs/verify/1618/replay.md). The live replay on a running stack was not run; prerequisites and the run path are in [LIVE-REPLAY-BLOCKED.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/33f09cfaa0b8754fb100fd9000e5e9139b143ec8/docs/verify/1618/LIVE-REPLAY-BLOCKED.md).
